partners.mechanism_chain: DSPP (HGNC:2703) —DISRUPTS→ Abnormal tooth dentin (HP:0001527); Abnormal tooth dentin (HP:0001527) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal dentin mineralization (HP:0000178); ITGA2B (HGNC:5524) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet activation (R-HSA-9016213); Platelet activation (R-HSA-9016213) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombocytopenia (HP:0001873).
